system.description:
Growing Unique (a shield +1, crawling with tiny creatures).

Dormant (when found, save DC 13): Advantage on saves against poison and disease.

Awakened (bearer 9th level, save DC 15): the shield is +2; once per day, cast summon swarm.

Exalted (bearer 17th level, save DC 17): the shield is +3; you can't be Poisoned.

Monsters & Treasure, Growing Uniques. Each state adds to the one before. It falls back to Dormant with a new bearer. Its bonus is +1 Dormant, +2 Awakened and +3 Exalted: raise it on the item when it wakes.
